text.en:
For the purpose of promoting international friendship and understanding, His Excellency,
Manuel L. Quezon, President of the Philippines, is authorized to accept the decoration known as the "Grand
Croix de l'Ordre de la Couronne," conferred upon him by His Majesty, Leopold III, the King of Belgium, and
to wear the insignia of the Order.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted, without Executive approval, June 8, 1940.
